title: Rank Math WordPress SEO plugin compromised with backdoors
excerpt: Downloads of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin from the official site contained malware that installed hidden backdoors in a supply-chain attack.
body_html: Certain downloads of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin, obtained directly from the vendor's official website, were found to contain malicious code. This supply-chain incident, which occurred last week, resulted in malware planting hidden backdoors onto affected websites.
